A run fails on any failure this file does not name, and on any line in this file whose case has started working. Regenerate with `rucc-corpus run --accept`, and read the whole story in the README under "What the compiler is known not to do".

known.why: rucc does not fold a const local in _Static_assert, an enumerator or a case label, which gcc does from -O1 up and this case pins -O2
rucc gives a conditional between an object pointer and a void * that is not a null pointer constant the type of its second operand instead of void *
rucc counts (char *)0 as a null pointer constant, so the _Generic in __is_const_zero sees void * and is_const answers 0 for every constant
rucc folds 0 && x to a constant when x is not one, so __is_constexpr(0 && x) is 1 where gcc says 0
